title: Preservation and definability for the fluted fragment
summary: This paper investigates preservation and definability for the equality-free fluted fragment over finite relational signatures. We first prove an equirank homomorphism preservation theorem: every homomorphism-preserved fluted sentence has an existential-positive fluted equivalent of no greater quantifier rank. We then refute Purdy's claimed Los--Tarski preservation theorem for the fluted fragment.
